messages:
ravi: FYI bringing up orion-11b (int4-quant) as a Dedicated canary tonight. seeing two issues: memory churn/temporary OOMs during long-response warmups, and a small ROUGE dip on long-document summarization. posting quick notes and an initial mitigation plan. :headphones:

liz: can you drop the runner snippet + repro steps?

ravi: runner (trimmed):
```
model: orion-11b-int4
batch_target: auto
max_new_tokens: 192
kv_prefetch: full
kv_prefetch_window: 0
slot_compactor_interval: 60s
soft_reserve: 0.10
```
repro: cold cluster, run 8 concurrent short chats (~150 tokens), then spike with a 2.5k-token generation. node hits low slots then one OOM; compactor reclaims and host recovers.

omar: any allocator excerpts? even a couple lines help.

ravi: pasted from node: 
```
[2026-03-23T12:04:12Z] gpu_alloc fail 1.1GiB
[2026-03-23T12:04:13Z] kv_live: 3.9GiB
[2026-03-23T12:04:14Z] free_slots_frac: 0.03
[2026-03-23T12:04:16Z] compactor reclaimed 580MiB
```

sylvia: looks like prefetch full is pulling everything; int4 helps model weights but activations and kv still dominate. two immediate knobs: limit prefetch window and trim older kv when active_gen > threshold.

chun: also consider lowering max_new_tokens default to 48 for the canary. Long tails are the main trigger for growth. Another operational trick: run a short-slot padding on warmup hosts (reserve extra 200MiB) to avoid immediate OOM.

liz: what about quality? where's the ROUGE drop concentrated?

ravi: long summaries >700 tokens show ~0.6 absolute ROUGE delta vs float baseline. Shorter summaries no meaningful delta. Suspect quantized KV encoding and positional accumulation causing drift for long context.

omar: propose canary config (rollback-safe):
- set max_new_tokens default = 48
- set kv_prefetch_window = 256 (instead of full prefetch)
- enable kv_trim_threshold = 512 tokens, kv_trim_ratio = 0.3
- set batch_pacing_ms = 40 on canary hosts
- reduce slot_compactor_interval to 25s
- warmup_hosts_soft_reserve = 0.15

chun: add perf target/alerts: p95 token latency < 150ms, memory cushion >= 512MiB after warmup, ROUGE >= baseline - 0.8. Fail fast rollback if cushion < 256MiB or ROUGE delta > 0.8.

sylvia: also schedule a per-layer quant-error snapshot: run FP32 vs INT4 activations on 50 long examples and store L2 error per layer. if error concentrates in early attention layers we may need per-layer remapping.

liz: canary rollout plan? percentages? duration? metrics capture?

ravi: start 5% of Dedicated pool, run for 6 hours or 5k requests (whichever first), capture summarization harness (200 long examples) + perf sweep. Will tag requests for trace sampling.

omar: infra note: I'll push a small scheduler patch to space microbatches slightly (30-60ms) to reduce allocation bursts. downside: small latency tail increase, but should smooth slab churn. patch id infra/sched/2026-03-23-11.

ops-bot: :gear: canary policy created for orion-11b-int4 -> 5% dedicated canary. ChangeSet: infra/2026-orion-canary-01.

chun: if ROUGE stays bad after trimming, fallback steps: 1) revert quant rollout for orion-11b to FP32 on Dedicated, 2) run per-layer symmetric quant vs asymmetric quant experiments, 3) consider hybrid scheme: int4 weights + fp16-KV for long gen paths.

sylvia: minor test: try lowering tokenizer max_chunk to avoid weird boundary tokens for long docs; sometimes tokenization differences interact with quant rounding.

liz: please open PR with config and test jobs. I'll wire the eval harness to compare ROUGE and token-level logprobs against baseline and set the alert rules.

ravi: PR #1982 opened. kicking off canary now. will post results in this thread in ~3-4 hours. :rocket:
